mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 79 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park, though the air quality index is currently elevated at 58. Tonight will bring a low of 64 degrees with no rain, and we have a Waxing Gibbous moon lighting the way for an ISS sighting at 10:25 PM, moving from the west over Mount Horeb toward the south near Belleville.

The City Clerk's office is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students to design the stickers for November's election; entries are due July 22 and public voting runs from July 28 through August 7. Also, residents are reminded to check their mailboxes for winter readiness and review the official damage policy to ensure they are compliant with postal standards.

There is plenty to do, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow at the Capitol, and more live music tomorrow at Paddy Mac's.

Looking at the weekly report, on July 14, an officer stopped a vehicle for driving without headlights and discovered marijuana, drug paraphernalia, and a firearm, leading to citations for the occupants.
Culver's is serving up Snickers Swirl today, and since they are open until 10:00 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
